export default "# Tips & Shortcuts\n\nPress Ctrl/Cmd+K to open the command palette. Quickly jump between pages, open settings, toggle themes, and load recent queries — all without leaving the keyboard. On narrow or mobile layouts, tap the search icon in the header to open the same palette.\n\nPress Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+A to toggle the AI Assistant drawer open or closed from any page.\n\nPress Ctrl/Cmd+Enter in Query Lab or Panel Editor to run the current ES|QL query without leaving the keyboard.\n\nUse Arrow Up/Down in Query Lab to navigate between rows while the row inspector is open. The inspector updates to show the newly selected row and the table scrolls to keep it visible.\n\nClick the dashboard title in the header to rename it inline.\n\nUse Dark/Light Mode in the settings menu to switch between light and dark mode.\n\nThe Disconnect button in the connection dialog drops the active connection.\n\nReset All State in the overflow menu wipes everything — connection and dashboards — back to defaults.\n"
